features.name: Qwen3-4B QLoRA finetune notebook
features.description: Unsloth QLoRA SFT notebook for Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct: combined+shuffled SFT, r=16, seq 2048, 1 epoch, train_on_responses_only; saves LoRA and GGUF q4_k_m. Runs on Kaggle T4; model choice justified against Phi-4-mini, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-3, SmolLM3-3B.

tests.notes: No separate harness (needs GPU + gitignored data) — the notebook asserts for itself: non-degenerate source counts, zero blank/NaN turns, qwen_lora/ written. Verified out-of-repo with stubbed unsloth/model: 2775 CounselChat - 163 blank and 3512 Amod - 4 blank -> 6120 examples; save cell without HF_TOKEN saves qwen_lora/ and skips both pushes; disabling the blank filter makes the notebook's own assert fire.

subtasks.name: Slim notebook to 17 cells + black format
HF-push cells must no-op on Kaggle

features.notes: DATA root is discovered by searching for counsel-chat/*.csv under /kaggle/input/datasets/<owner>/<slug>/ (Kaggle's current mount layout; older images used /kaggle/input/<slug>/) and falling back to data/finetune/, so a mount-path change fails loudly instead of silently training on nothing. Blank CSV fields arrive as NaN/None, so the filter rejects those too. Use enable_thinking=False, temp 0.7 / top_p 0.8. VRAM on 8GB laptop: Qwen SFT@2048 ~6.5-7.5GB fits. GGUF + hub pushes need HF_TOKEN, so Kaggle runs produce qwen_lora/ only.

features.notes: v3 (2026-10-14) COMPLETE in ~59 min on T4 x2 (~0.9 GPU-h): 6,120 examples, 765 steps, 1 epoch, batch 2x4, r=16. TrainOutput: train_loss 2.3051, train_runtime 3391.1s, 1.805 samples/s, epoch 1.0. Sanity inference coherent (anxiety prompt -> CBT/exposure/mindfulness guidance, non-thinking). qwen_lora/ (132MB adapter, 7 modules) + tokenizer fetched to models/ (gitignored). Per-step loss curve lives only in the Kaggle UI log — the fetched log is sampled and drops it, so the endpoint stats above are the in-repo record. Kaggle CLI cannot attach secrets, so training only; HF push happens from local (F007).

features.name: Publish adapters to Hugging Face
features.description: Push the fine-tuned LoRA and GGUF artifacts from the laptop to arnabwithab/ai-therapist-qwen3-4b-lora and ...-gguf using HF_TOKEN from .env.
features.notes: F007-1 done 2026-10-14: v3 1-epoch adapter + tokenizer uploaded to arnabwithab/ai-therapist-qwen3-4b-lora (public) via huggingface_hub, verified 11 files via API. Overwrite with the 2-epoch adapter when SFT v4 lands (re-upload README.md afterwards — upload_folder would clobber it with Unsloth's default; card source: models/qwen_lora/README.md). Done 2026-10-14: v4 adapter + user's edited card live (repo sha e2001fe2); card canonical backup at models/MODEL_CARD.md (updated for v4: 2 epochs, loss 1.9842). Auth note: login()/library whoami worked as arnabwithab (token autolinksv2, write) while curl Bearer checks 401'd with the same string — uploads must go through the library, not curl. F007-2 blocked: GGUF export needs ~8-10GB disk + unsloth/torch/triton locally, laptop has 6.5GB free; options are freeing disk or a Kaggle export kernel with a UI-attached HF secret. 2026-10-15: third path taken — CPU-only Kaggle kernel eros438/ai-therapist-gguf-export (code notebooks/gguf-export/export_gguf.py). v1 (Unsloth merge) died at import: Unsloth hard-requires a GPU. v2 uses transformers+peft merge_and_unload (~8GB RAM, Kaggle CPU has 30GB) plus a minimal llama.cpp build (llama-quantize target only) for Q4_K_M; fp16 intermediates are deleted to stay under /kaggle/working's 20GB. v3 got further (merge succeeded) then died serializing the merged-bnb model: transformers save_pretrained cannot reverse bnb weight conversions (NotImplementedError). v4 back to the Unsloth path on T4 (save_pretrained_gguf does its own serialization): needs ~20 min against 0.16h quota, likely dies mid-run — user's explicit call. Fetch the .gguf with kernels output and upload from local. FUTURE EXPORTS: if GPU quota is available, convert directly via Unsloth save_pretrained_gguf on a T4 kernel (one call does merge+quant, ~20 min) instead of this CPU path — use CPU only when quota is dry. v4 SUCCEEDED 2026-10-15 (Unsloth merge+quant on T4, burned the last 0.15h, 0.01h left): Q4_K_M 2.5GB (renamed ai-therapist-qwen3-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf) + README live at arnabwithab/ai-therapist-qwen3-4b-gguf (public, verified via API).

features.notes: DPO@2048 needs ~9–11GB, will not fit the 8GB laptop. SFT epoch-2 contemplated 2026-10-14: v3 curve (765 posted steps) descends ~2.55 -> ~2.15 with no plateau and persistent batch-noise spikes, so a 2nd epoch should gain another ~0.15-0.3; cheapest path is a fresh run with num_train_epochs=2 (~2 GPU-h, keep both adapters, compare under F009/F010 when those land). Launched 2026-10-14 as SFT kernel v4 (only change vs v3: epochs 1 -> 2; same seed, so epoch 1 reproduces v3 and epoch 2 auto-reshuffles). v4 COMPLETE: train_loss 1.9842 (vs 2.3051), runtime 6817.7s, epoch-2 block descends ~2.5 -> ~1.6 with no plateau; full 1,530-step curve saved as models/log_history.json (gitignored). features.name: MentalBench-Align evaluation harness
features.description: Automated counselling-quality evaluation using the MentalBench-Align repo (CSS = Guidance/Informativeness/Relevance/Safety; ARS = Empathy/Helpfulness/Understanding) with its 1–5 rubrics plus judge prompt and JSON schema, including a human spot-check on Safety/Relevance.

features.name: MentalBench-100k Qwen3-4B baseline
features.description: Generate a fresh Qwen3-4B baseline over MentalBench-100k (10k rows) on Kaggle T4 fp16 with the paper's generation prompt, enable_thinking=False, temp 0.7 / top_p 0.8, max 512 tokens. One kernel drives both T4s (two worker subprocesses, one GPU each via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES) writing a single sorted idx,context,qwen3_4b_instruct_2507 CSV.

tests.notes: Not in repo — canonical output data/eval/mbench-qwen3-4b-baseline/output_mbench.csv (10,000 rows, idx 0-9999, no gaps, 0 empty; gitignored, like the finetune data). Seed dataset eros438/ai-therapist-mbench-seed (private) holds the original shard CSVs; rebuild with: kaggle datasets version -p data/eval/mbench-qwen3-4b-baseline (see data/eval/mbench-qwen3-4b-baseline/dataset-metadata.json).

subtasks.name: Push v2 kernels with aligned metadata slugs
Fetch both shard outputs and merge
Judge pass with a current API model
Re-run the remaining 8,219 rows with batched generation (required, not optional)

features.notes: Kernels eros438/ai-therapist-qwen3-mbench-{a-rows-0-5000,b-rows-5000-10000} both CANCEL_ACKNOWLEDGED (killed at the 9h cap). Outputs (2026-10-14): shard A 906 rows idx 0-905, shard B 875 rows idx 5000-5874, no gaps/dupes, 0 empty, 1781/10000 = 18% coverage. Rate ~35-37 s/row (~100 rows/h/kernel), so a full 5000-row shard needs ~50 GPU-h — unbatched single-stream fp16 generation is the bottleneck. FUTURE RUNS MUST USE BATCHED GENERATION (vLLM, or HF generate with left-padding at batch 8-16); do not re-run single-stream, it cannot finish inside the 30h/week GPU quota. Resume works only if the partial CSV is re-attached as an input dataset (both runs logged resume skipped=0 on a fresh /kaggle/working). vLLM rerun eros438/ai-therapist-qwen3-mbench-vllm pushed 2026-10-14 (code eval/mbench_baseline/generate.py, kernel-metadata.json): tensor_parallel_size=2 on T4 x2, max_model_len=2048, chunks of 256 prompts, same paper prompt and temp 0.7 / top_p 0.8 / 512 tokens; seed dataset eros438/ai-therapist-mbench-seed attached so the 1,781 existing rows are copied in, not regenerated. v1 failed at import: bare `pip install vllm` pulls cu130 torch while Kaggle's torchaudio stays cu128 (vLLM's import chain touches torchaudio); v2's cu128 pre-install did not hold because vLLM >= 0.28 pins torch==2.13.0 exactly (cu130-only), so pip upgraded torch anyway. v3 pins vllm==0.25.0 (torch/torchaudio==2.11.0, all on the cu128 index) with --upgrade-strategy only-if-needed — verified against PyPI metadata before pushing. v3 then failed differently (ImportError: libcudart.so.13 — vLLM 0.25.0's compiled extension needs CUDA 13 libs absent from Kaggle's CUDA 12.8 image), so vLLM is abandoned after three import-time deaths. Replacement kernel eros438/ai-therapist-qwen3-mbench-batched (code eval/mbench_baseline/generate.py): plain HF generate, batch 8 with left padding, parent + two subprocess workers each masked to one GPU via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, same prompt and sampling params; seed/partial CSVs attached as datasets are copied in, so a cap-killed run resumes by re-attaching its partial output. Batched run COMPLETE 2026-10-14/15 in ~6.5h: both workers held 630-651 rows/h with no decay, DONE 10000/10000, merged output verified (10k unique idx, 0 empty). Part files and kernel log deleted; output_mbench.csv is canonical. 50% of the 1781 responses are cut mid-sentence at the 512-token cap — caveat for the judge pass. Paper's GPT-4o/Claude-3.7/Gemini-2.5 judges are deprecated; their stored Qwen-3 scores are NOT reusable, so a fresh baseline is required (needs API keys + budget).

features.name: FastAPI serving layer
features.description: OpenAI-compatible backend for the counsellor: thin FastAPI routes over backend/core/chat.py, which injects src/rag/query.py:retrieve() context and forwards to the vLLM GGUF model server. Non-streaming; anse points its Base URL here.

tests.notes: 16 tests green (8 chat + 8 routes; MockTransport model, stubbed retrieve). No network/GPU in tests.

subtasks.name: Core chat logic (RAG injection, stateless, model call)

features.notes: Stateless by design: history arrives in the OpenAI messages array, last user turn drives retrieval. Endpoints: GET /health, GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (stream:true -> 400, no user turn -> 422, RAG/model failure -> 502). Run with `make serve` (port 8001, VLLM_URL default http://localhost:8000).

features.notes: open-webui evaluated and rejected: 482MB repo, custom proprietary license (NOASSERTION), Svelte+Python stack. anse wins on all three (MIT, 1MB, TS) and its OpenAI provider exposes Base URL + handles non-streaming responses; the backend ignores the client model field, so any model label works.
